question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

I will __strive__ to win the race.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"strive"** means to make great efforts to achieve or obtain something. (प्रयास करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She will **strive **to improve her grades this semester.
 
 
 
• **"Attempt"** refers to making an effort to achieve or complete something. (प्रयास करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He will **attempt** to solve the problem before the deadline.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'strive'** is **'attempt'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Trouble** (मुसीबत): Difficulty or problems.

 
 
• **Example:** He ran into trouble with his car on the way to work.
 
 
 
• **Support** (सहायता): To bear all or part of the weight; hold up.
 
 
• **Example:** Her family provided her with much-needed support during her difficult times.
 
 
 
• **Assume** (मान लेना): To take for granted or without proof.
 
 
• **Example:** I assume that he has finished his homework.
